test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a park there are rabbits and pigeons in the ratio 4 : 9. If legs are counted, the total number of legs is 340. Find the number of rabbits.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Rabbits : Pigeons = 4 : 9

Ratio of their legs = (4 × 4) : (9 × 2) = 16 : 18

Total proportional legs = 16 + 18 = 34 units

Given total legs = 340 ⇒ 1 unit = 340 ÷ 34 = 10

Number of rabbits = 4 units × 10 = 40

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Rabbits to Pigeons = 4 : 9

Total number of legs = 340

**Formula Used:**

Total Legs = (Number of Rabbits × 4) + (Number of Pigeons × 2)

 
 Rabbits (4x)
 Ratio 4
 
 
 Pigeons (9x)
 Ratio 9
 
 
• 
 
 Legs per Rabbit = 4
 Legs per Pigeon = 2
 
 Total Legs = 340

Let the common multiplier be x.

⇒ Number of rabbits = 4x

⇒ Number of pigeons = 9x

⇒ Total legs = (4x × 4) + (9x × 2)

⇒ 340 = 16x + 18x

⇒ 340 = 34x

⇒ x = 340 ÷ 34

⇒ x = 10

⇒ Number of rabbits = 4 × 10 = 40

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Animal Leg Logic

In animal counting problems, assume rabbits/four-legged animals have 4 legs and pigeons/birds/two-legged animals have 2 legs.

Head and Leg Formula

If Total Heads (H) and Total Legs (L) are given, the number of four-legged animals = (L − 2H) ÷ 2.

Ratio Scaling

If entities are in ratio a : b, their actual values are ax and bx where x is the common multiplier determined by the total value condition.

Alligation Method

This problem can also be solved using alligation if the total number of animals (heads) is known by comparing the average legs per animal.
